question: Does Fourier specifically amplify the reward-transfer benefit of multiplicative FiLM?
run_name: Do Fourier and FiLM cooperate? | fixed H4 | missing raw shift control
primary_endpoint: At1000, paired fixed-H4 reward interaction: (Fourier FiLM minus Fourier shift) minus (raw FiLM minus raw shift). Four simple effects accompany it in one simultaneous95 family. Re-score all four arms on the same16384 held-out IID contexts, one draw/context; no best-of-K.
decision_rule: A material positive interaction requires simultaneous lower95>0.01; negative interaction upper95<-0.01. An interval wholly within[-0.01,0.01] supports only a small interaction at this margin. Otherwise unresolved, NOT no interaction. Simple effects use the same material margin. No AUC=.5 requirement; fresh audits and joint metrics diagnose what changed. Undertrained audits cannot establish closure. Stop after1000 and summarize before another experiment.

fixed_conditions.reward: Same frozen full-truth H4 from reward_shape_failure_early1k_v1; no oracle, rescaling, refit or shape-matched target
fixed_conditions.objective: Unmodified native detached DGPO, unscaled LOO, coefficient1 times HALF velocity-MSE
fixed_conditions.optimizer: AdamW1e-4 weight_decay.001 clip1; same sampling/RNG clocks across audit pauses; raw, never EMA
fixed_conditions.sampling: Batch64 K8 M4 DDIM50, all1000 policy updates; one existing training seed
fixed_conditions.architecture: Two-layer32-wide SiLU condition encoder, new-branch LayerNorm and three modulation sites. Raw repeats sqrt(3)*c in8 slots; Fourier uses1/2/4/8. Same nominal parameters, not equal active rank or capacity.

scope: Separately authorized follow-up19 to the completed18-round toy campaign; do not modify its ledger or paused automation. Train ONLY raw shift from step0, not by disabling heads on a trained FiLM endpoint. Reuse and verify three saved controls. Adaptive exploratory factorial completion: intervals condition on fitted models and reuse old evaluation data, not confirmation across seeds. Equal updates are not equal FLOPs or velocity distance. User launches locally; no production, remote jobs or uploads.
